nl.title: WordPress URL omzetten van http naar https
nl.excerpt: Zet WordPress-URL’s op HTTPS na SSL: siteurl/home en force redirect.
nl.bodyHtml:
Na Let’s Encrypt moet WP zelf op https:// staan om mixed content en redirect-loops te voorkomen.

Voorbereiding

  • Geldig SSL-certificaat
  • wp-admin toegang

Stappen

  1. Installeer SSL in DirectAdmin
  2. Force SSL / redirect in panel indien beschikbaar
  3. WP → Instellingen → Algemeen: beide URL’s op https://
  4. Of pas toe via Installatron/WP-CLI search-replace
  5. Purge caches
  6. Test

Controleren

  • Hangslot ok
  • Geen mixed content op kernpagina’s

Tip: Check elementor/CDN caches apart.

Let op: Alleen .htaccess redirect zonder URL-opties in WP geeft vaak login-loops.

Kom je er na deze stappen niet uit? Open een ticket bij TripleZero iT via het klantenpanel. Vermeld hostname, DirectAdmin-gebruikersnaam (geen wachtwoord), domein en wat je al probeerde.

Gerelateerd: letsencrypt-da; installatron.

en.title: WordPress URL omzetten of http to https
en.excerpt: Let’s Encrypt / SSL in DirectAdmin: DNS first, request certificate, then force HTTPS.
en.bodyHtml:
For “WordPress URL omzetten of http to https”, DNS (A/AAAA) must already point at this server. Then request the certificate in DirectAdmin → SSL Certificates.

Preparation

  • A/AAAA to TripleZero iT hosting
  • DirectAdmin login
  • Apex and www if both are used

Steps

  1. Confirm the domain A/AAAA record points at this server.
  2. Sign in to DirectAdmin → SSL Certificates (or Let’s Encrypt / Free & automatic certificate).
  3. Select the domain and include www if needed.
  4. Request the certificate and wait until status is valid/issued.
  5. Force HTTPS via the panel option or .htaccess only after successful issuance.
  6. Test https://yourdomain in a private window.

Verify

  • Padlock without name mismatch
  • http redirects to https

Tip: Cover apex and www in one certificate.

Note: Forcing HTTPS without a certificate causes browser errors.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with TripleZero iT via the client panel. Include your domain name, what you already tried, and any exact error messages (text or screenshot).

Related: DNS A record, WordPress URL to HTTPS.
